title: IdeaSeek Overleaf export manifest (overleaf-export-v1)
description: Structural contract for the OverleafManifest that src/paper/overleaf.ts buildOverleafExport returns and writes as <bundleDir>/manifest.json. Checked structurally: the contract tag the writer itself sets, where the bundle and the ZIP live, and that every bundled file is listed with a byte count and a content digest — the manifest is the audit trail for what left the project, so an entry without a digest is not an entry. Left in the domain module on purpose: that the ZIP was really produced (a failed zip throws ENV_UNSUPPORTED after the manifest is already written, so zipPath is a claim, not a fact the schema can check), that no secret is inside, and which venue style files were copied. No path in `files` is required: the manifest.json written to disk is serialized before its own entry is appended, so the persisted list omits manifest.json while the returned/printed one contains it — pinning either would reject an artifact the platform legitimately produces.
